title: call-path
summary: Finds the shortest resolved call path from one symbol to another
intro: Read this when you want to know whether routine A ever reaches routine B and how. call-path prints the shortest resolved call path between two symbols, and exits 1 when there is none.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint call-path --from <A> --to <B> [--max-depth N] --db PATH [--json] (shortest resolved call path A -> ... -> B; exit 1 = no path)
help: drag-lint call-path --from <A> --to <B> [--max-depth N] --db PATH [--json]   (shortest resolved call path A -> ... -> B; exit 1 = no path)

surfaces.path: drag-lint > Uses & Dependencies > Call Path Between Two Routines...
